## zipzi.modeling.DeletionPositionGuarantee

## zipzi.modeling.DeletionRequest

`(roots: tuple[DeletionTarget, ...], reparent: _Mapping[str, ReparentStrategy] = field(default_factory=lambda: {key0: read_ReparentStrategy(v0) for key0, v0 in record({}).items()}), conversion_context: ReparentContext | None = None, offscreen_placements: _Mapping[str, DeletionOffscreenPlacement] = field(default_factory=lambda: {key0: read_DeletionOffscreenPlacement(v0) for key0, v0 in record({}).items()}), tolerance: DeletionTolerance = field(default_factory=lambda: read_DeletionTolerance({'absolute': 0.001, 'relative': 1e-06})), parameter_slices: _Mapping[str, float] = field(default_factory=lambda: {key0: number(v0) for key0, v0 in record({}).items()}), texture_replacements: _Mapping[str, str | None] = field(default_factory=lambda: {key0: None if v0 is None else string(v0) for key0, v0 in record({}).items()}), physics_node_replacements: _Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=lambda: {key0: string(v0) for key0, v0 in record({}).items()}), blend_base_replacements: _Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=lambda: {key0: string(v0) for key0, v0 in record({}).items()}))`

Immutable owned DeletionRequest value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `roots`: Explicit typed roots and individual scope choices; order does not change the result.
- `reparent`: Explicit migration strategy by surviving object ID; KeepLocalData on a dissolved Part accepts its state loss.
- `conversion_context`: Frozen parameter inputs, finite domains and reference time; None uses document defaults and full declared domains.
- `offscreen_placements`: Explicit retained Part owners and mapping resolutions for surviving Offscreens.
- `tolerance`: Absolute and geometry-scale-relative position error allowed by conversion proofs.
- `parameter_slices`: Explicit finite parameter slice coordinates; absent entries use frozen document defaults, never preview sliders.
- `texture_replacements`: Resolution by deleted texture UUID; Some redirects to a retained texture and None explicitly leaves users unconfigured.
- `physics_node_replacements`: Explicit replacement by removed Physics node UUID; replacement must remain in that native setting group.
- `blend_base_replacements`: Explicit retained base sample when deleting a Blend table base.

## zipzi.modeling.Drawable

`(id: str, runtime_id: str, part_id: str, raw_blend_mode: int | None = None, texture_asset_id: str, texture_slot: int, renderable: bool = True, positions: tuple[Vec2, ...], uvs: tuple[Vec2, ...], indices: tuple[int, ...], draw_order: int, render_order: int, opacity: float, multiply_color: tuple[float, float, float, float], screen_color: tuple[float, float, float, float], blend_mode: BlendMode, enabled: bool, visible: bool, double_sided: bool, inverted_mask: bool, masks: tuple[str, ...])`

Immutable owned Drawable value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `id`: Stable document object ID used by references; it is distinct from the exported runtime_id.
- `runtime_id`: External format/runtime identifier retained for import/export; not the document object ID.
- `part_id`: Organizational Part owner ID; independent of the deformation parent. An empty string
represents the root/unassigned container.
- `raw_blend_mode`: Original format-specific blend-mode code; None means no preserved raw code.
- `texture_asset_id`: Resolved image-asset object ID used by this drawable; separate from its evaluated
texture slot.
- `texture_slot`: Resolved texture slot index; separate from the persistent texture asset ID.
- `renderable`: Geometry remains editable when this resource cannot contribute color.
- `positions`: Final evaluated XY vertex positions in Y-up model units; ordered for indices and UVs.
- `uvs`: Texture UV pairs ordered by vertex_ids; keep one UV for each position.
- `indices`: Flattened triangle indices into evaluated positions/UVs; these are offsets, not
authoring vertex IDs.
- `draw_order`: Evaluated integer drawing-order coordinate before final render sorting.
- `render_order`: Final evaluated drawing sequence rank after hierarchy and group ordering.
- `opacity`: Finite nonnegative opacity factor; 0 is transparent and 1 is opaque. Imported values
above 1 are retained without clamping.
- `multiply_color`: Evaluated RGBA multiply factors, channel order R, G, B, A.
- `screen_color`: Evaluated RGBA screen factors, channel order R, G, B, A.
- `blend_mode`: Compositing mode used when drawing this object.
- `enabled`: Whether this object participates in evaluation; editor hiding is a separate state.
- `visible`: Whether the evaluated object is visible after hierarchical visibility rules.
- `double_sided`: Whether both triangle faces contribute to drawing.
- `inverted_mask`: Whether to invert the combined clipping mask for this drawable.
- `masks`: Ordered stable mesh IDs used as clipping-mask sources, not texture IDs.

- `id`: Stable document object ID used by references; it is distinct from the exported runtime_id.

- `points`: Final model coordinates (X-right/Y-up), matching
Drawable::positions. Warp points are row-major; rotation points are the
transformed origin and unit X/Y axes.
- `rotation_axis`: Unit direction of the rotation's local X axis in model space, evaluated
without translation or scale so tiny imported scales retain their angle.
- `rotation_basis`: Local X/Y basis vectors with evaluated scale and reflections, before
translation. Unlike subtracting points, these retain small rotation
coefficients at large model origins.

## zipzi.modeling.EvaluatedParameter

`(id: str, requested: float, value: float, clamped: bool)`

Immutable owned EvaluatedParameter value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `id`: Stable document object ID used by references; it is distinct from the exported runtime_id.
- `requested`: Requested parameter value before range/repeat handling, in the parameter domain.
- `value`: Effective parameter value after native range/repeat handling, in the parameter domain.
- `clamped`: Whether the effective parameter value differs due to range clamping.

## zipzi.modeling.ExportSettings

`(pixels_per_unit: float, bounds: tuple[float, float, float, float] | None = None, padding_fraction: float, padding_pixels: float, minimum_extent: float)`

Immutable owned ExportSettings value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `pixels_per_unit`: Positive model-length to Cubism-runtime-unit conversion scale at the file boundary;
model units themselves remain canvas-pixel lengths.
- `bounds`: Optional stable rectangle [left, bottom, right, top] in model units.
Specified bounds bypass automatic padding; pixel edges round outwards.
- `padding_fraction`: Fractional export padding relative to the frame extent; dimensionless.
- `padding_pixels`: Additional export padding measured in pixels.
- `minimum_extent`: Finite nonnegative minimum automatic export extent in model units; native default is 256.

`(added: int, moved: int, removed: int, shape_count: int, reconnected: bool, glue_endpoints: bool, non_affine_parent: bool, affine_extension: bool, appearance_limits: tuple[str, ...], cost: ConversionCost)`

## zipzi.modeling.Mesh

`(id: str, name: str, texture_asset_id: SceneReference, vertex_ids: tuple[int, ...], base_positions: tuple[Vec2, ...], uvs: tuple[Vec2, ...], triangles: tuple[tuple[int, int, int], ...], meshing: MeshMeshing | None = None, runtime_id: str, part_id: str, deformer_id: str, appearance: Appearance, draw_order: float | None = None, blend_mode: BlendMode, enabled: bool, double_sided: bool, inverted_mask: bool, masks: tuple[str, ...], raw_blend_mode: int | None = None)`

Immutable owned Mesh value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `id`: Stable document object ID used by references; it is distinct from the exported runtime_id.
- `name`: Human-readable display name; use the stable ID for identity because names can change.
- `texture_asset_id`: Image-asset reference; resolved values name the asset object ID and unresolved values
preserve an external texture identifier.
- `vertex_ids`: Stable u32 vertex IDs in the same order as positions and UVs; IDs need not be contiguous.
- `base_positions`: Absolute base-shape XY positions in the mesh authoring space, ordered by vertex_ids.
- `uvs`: Texture UV pairs ordered by vertex_ids; keep one UV for each position.
- `triangles`: Triangle triples of stable vertex IDs; preserve winding and do not substitute position-
array offsets.
- `meshing`: Optional single-region modeling topology in UV space; independent of posed positions.
- `runtime_id`: External format/runtime identifier retained for import/export; not the document object ID.
- `part_id`: Organizational Part owner ID; independent of the deformation parent. An empty string
represents the root/unassigned container.
- `deformer_id`: Parent deformation transform ID; an empty string means model space.
- `appearance`: Opacity and multiply/screen color factors for this object or shape.
- `draw_order`: Drawing-order coordinate; distinct from the final evaluated render_order. None leaves
this channel unspecified for native evaluation.
- `blend_mode`: Compositing mode used when drawing this object.
- `enabled`: Whether this object participates in evaluation; editor hiding is a separate state.
- `double_sided`: Whether both triangle faces contribute to drawing.
- `inverted_mask`: Whether to invert the combined clipping mask for this drawable.
- `masks`: Ordered stable mesh IDs used as clipping-mask sources, not texture IDs.
- `raw_blend_mode`: Original format-specific blend-mode code; None means no preserved raw code.

Immutable owned MeshKeyform value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

coordinates.

unoverridden order.

`(boundary: tuple[int, ...], constraints: tuple[MeshConstraint, ...])`

Immutable owned MeshMeshing value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `constraints`: Internal constraints sorted by their canonical endpoint pairs; excludes boundary edges.

## zipzi.modeling.MeshQuality

`(mesh_id: str, visible: bool, vertex_count: int, triangles: tuple[TriangleQuality, ...], min_angle_degrees: float | None = None, max_aspect_ratio: float | None = None, max_edge_stretch: float | None = None, degenerate_triangles: int, flipped_triangles: int, texture_coverage: TextureCoverage | None = None)`

Immutable owned MeshQuality value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `mesh_id`: Stable document mesh ID, in evaluated drawable order.
- `visible`: Evaluated enabled/visible/positive-opacity state. Metrics are geometric and ignore occlusion.
- `vertex_count`: Number of evaluated vertices.
- `triangles`: Per-triangle metrics in evaluated Y-up model coordinates, relative to default parameters
of the same frozen authoring source. This does not certify unsampled parameter intervals.
- `min_angle_degrees`: Smallest angle over this mesh; None for an empty mesh.
- `max_aspect_ratio`: Largest finite aspect ratio; collapsed triangles are counted separately.
- `max_edge_stretch`: Largest finite symmetric edge-length ratio relative to the default pose.
- `degenerate_triangles`: Number of exactly zero-area evaluated triangles.
- `flipped_triangles`: Number of negative relative-area triangles. Degenerate references are excluded.
- `texture_coverage`: Optional source-texture coverage. CPU-only sampling does not resolve image pixels.

## zipzi.modeling.Model3Settings

`(groups: tuple[ModelParameterGroup, ...] | None = None, layout: _Mapping[str, float] | None = None, hit_areas: tuple[ModelHitArea, ...] | None = None, user_data: AttachmentRef | None = None, extensions: _Mapping[str, ExtensionValue], source_runtime_ids: _Mapping[str, str] | None = None, source_content: str | None = None)`

Immutable owned Model3Settings value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `groups`: Optional ordered model3 parameter groups; None preserves omission rather than an empty list.
- `layout`: Optional model3 numeric layout map; None preserves omission and an empty map is
explicitly empty.
- `hit_areas`: Optional ordered named hit-area records with stable mesh references; None preserves
omission.
- `user_data`: Optional model3 user-data attachment reference; None means the field was omitted.
- `extensions`: Preserved opaque import/export extension fields; retain unknown keys when editing known
fields.
- `source_runtime_ids`: Provenance is needed only for opaque metadata and unmanaged IDs inside UserData.
- `source_content`: Preserved opaque imported model3 source metadata; None means none was retained.

- `meshes`: Explicit IDs of meshes to read, in result-slot order; an empty list requests no
payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `parameters`: Explicit IDs of parameters to read, in result-slot order; an empty list requests no
payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `parts`: Explicit IDs of Parts to read, in result-slot order; an empty list requests no payloads,
while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `transforms`: Explicit IDs of deformation transforms to read, in result-slot order; an empty list
requests no payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `bindings`: Explicit IDs of ordinary mesh bindings to read, in result-slot order; an empty list
requests no payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `scene_bindings`: Explicit IDs of scene bindings to read, in result-slot order; an empty list requests no
payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `blend_key_tables`: Explicit IDs of BlendShape key tables to read, in result-slot order; an empty list
requests no payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `blend_constraints`: Explicit IDs of BlendShape constraints to read, in result-slot order; an empty list
requests no payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `blend_bindings`: Explicit IDs of BlendShape bindings to read, in result-slot order; an empty list
requests no payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `glues`: Explicit IDs of Glue objects to read, in result-slot order; an empty list requests no
payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `offscreens`: Explicit IDs of Offscreen objects to read, in result-slot order; an empty list requests
no payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `parameter_groups`: Explicit IDs of CDI parameter groups to read, in result-slot order; an empty list
requests no payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `attachments`: Explicit IDs of package attachments to read, in result-slot order; an empty list
requests no payloads, while collection IDs remain discoverable.
- `motions`: Explicit motion clip IDs; payload slots follow order and retain missing IDs.
- `motion_groups`: Explicit motion registration-group IDs; group payloads include their ordered entries.
- `motion_registrations`: Explicit registration IDs, including root and grouped registrations.
- `expressions`: Explicit expression asset IDs; entries are owned by the selected asset.
- `physics`: Request the Physics singleton payload; false requests no Physics content.
- `pose`: Request the Pose singleton payload; false requests no Pose content.

## zipzi.modeling.ModelingSamples

`(version: _Version, parameters: tuple[_Mapping[str, float], ...], frames: tuple[DrawableFrame, ...], diagnostics: tuple[GeometryDiagnostic, ...], quality: tuple[tuple[MeshQuality, ...], ...])`

Immutable owned ModelingSamples value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `version`: Exact SDK version captured for this value; not a best-effort latest-version marker.
- `parameters`: Effective parameter maps in the same order as requested poses; each map is keyed by
document parameter ID.
- `frames`: CPU-evaluated frames in the same order as requested parameter maps.
- `diagnostics`: Structured diagnostics from this query or operation; an empty list means none were reported.
- `quality`: Per-pose evaluated mesh quality in frame order when Checks.quality is true; empty otherwise.
Uses default parameters of this same frozen source as the reference, without image coverage.

## zipzi.modeling.MotionCapabilities

`(inspect: CapabilityState, patch: CapabilityState, duplicate: CapabilityState, delete: CapabilityState, move_object: CapabilityState, preview: CapabilityState, create_child: CapabilityState, reorder: CapabilityState, repair: CapabilityState, edit_content: CapabilityState)`

Immutable owned MotionCapabilities value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `inspect`: Read this object while its identity/context remains valid.
- `patch`: Modify typed fields through a validated native intent/address.
- `duplicate`: Duplicate the selected object while allocating fresh owned identities.
- `delete`: Delete the selected object subject to native reference and lock rules.
- `move_object`: Move the selected object between compatible native owners.
- `preview`: Native preview eligibility; host preview API availability is advertised separately.
- `create_child`: Create owned child rows in this object.
- `reorder`: Change ordered sibling membership without changing identity.
- `repair`: Repair an explicitly unresolved native reference.
- `edit_content`: Edit the owning clip content, preserving stable track/key/event identities.

## zipzi.modeling.MotionClip

`(id: str, name: str, duration: float, fps: float, looping: bool, restricted_beziers: bool, fade_in: float | None = None, fade_out: float | None = None, track_order: tuple[str, ...], tracks: tuple[MotionTrack, ...], events: tuple[MotionEvent, ...], extensions: _Mapping[str, ExtensionValue], meta_extensions: _Mapping[str, ExtensionValue], opaque_source_ids: _Mapping[str, str] | None = None, opaque_source_content_hash: str | None = None)`

Immutable owned MotionClip value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `id`: Stable identity in the owning authoring domain; exported metadata IDs retain their source text.
- `name`: Human-readable display or registration name; distinct from persistent object identity.
- `duration`: Motion playback duration in seconds; authoring keys may retain source-range provenance.
- `fps`: Nominal motion frames per second or explicit Physics fixed-step frequency, as declared by the owner.
- `looping`: Whether motion playback repeats after its duration.
- `restricted_beziers`: Whether motion Bezier export follows the restricted control-time convention.
- `fade_in`: Optional fade-in duration in seconds; None retains the format/runtime default.
- `fade_out`: Optional fade-out duration in seconds; None retains the format/runtime default.
- `track_order`: Display order only; tracks retain their execution order. Empty uses execution order.
- `tracks`: Ordered persistent motion tracks; playback state is owned separately.
- `events`: Ordered owned events in the motion clip; reading them does not advance playback.
- `extensions`: Owned opaque imported fields preserved for format roundtrips; declared fields cannot be shadowed.
- `meta_extensions`: Owned opaque motion metadata fields preserved for format roundtrips.
- `opaque_source_ids`: Original runtime-ID namespace used to validate preservation of opaque imported fields.
- `opaque_source_content_hash`: Original imported-content hash used to detect unsupported changes to opaque fields.

## zipzi.modeling.MotionSnapshot

`(physics: tuple[PhysicsRigSnapshot, ...] = (), time: float, parameters: _Mapping[str, float], part_opacity_channels: _Mapping[str, float], part_opacities: _Mapping[str, float], model_opacity: float, active_motions: tuple[str, ...], active_expressions: tuple[str, ...], fired_events: tuple[MotionEventFired, ...], coverage: tuple[str, ...], motion_positions: tuple[MotionPlaybackPosition, ...])`

Immutable owned MotionSnapshot value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `physics`: Optional inspector observations. Collected explicitly by a host after
evaluation. Advance/seek results leave this empty; populate it with
`snapshot.physics = preview.physics_snapshot();` when displaying an inspector.
Internal observations are retained in replay checkpoints for consistent seeks.
- `time`: Absolute preview time in seconds.
- `parameters`: Final parameter values keyed by parameter UUID.
- `part_opacity_channels`: PartOpacity curves write virtual controls when no real parameter has the Part runtime ID.
- `part_opacities`: Pose-produced opacities keyed by Part UUID.
- `model_opacity`: Model Opacity channel, separate from the drawable geometry opacity.
- `active_motions`: Active clip UUIDs in queue order; repeated activations may repeat a UUID.
- `active_expressions`: Active expression UUIDs in queue order, including fading-out entries.
- `fired_events`: Events crossed by the last update, not accumulated across all seek steps.
- `coverage`: Model EyeBlink/LipSync mappings and unsupported Model IDs are reported.
- `motion_positions`: SDK sampling coordinates, including the duration + 1 / FPS loop tail.

`(width: int, height: int, rgba: _Bytes, png: _Bytes, document_id: str, evaluation_revision: int, capture_id: str, scene_digest: str, render_digest: str, input_sha256: str, adapter_name: str, adapter_backend: str, parameters: _Mapping[str, float], visible_roi: tuple[float, float, float, float], scale: float, offset: tuple[float, float], textures: tuple[ObservedTexture, ...], drawable_bounds: tuple[ObservedBounds, ...], quality: tuple[MeshQuality, ...])`

Immutable owned ObservationImage value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `width`: Output image width in pixels.
- `height`: Output image height in pixels.
- `rgba`: Raw renderer RGBA8, row-major, top-left image origin. Renderer alpha convention is preserved.
- `png`: PNG encoding of exactly the returned RGBA8; encoded by Rust, never by Python.
- `document_id`: Captured authoring document UUID.
- `evaluation_revision`: Captured geometry evaluation revision, distinct from the outer formal/candidate Source.
- `capture_id`: Shared acquisition UUID for this batch's once-resolved immutable texture set.
- `scene_digest`: Digest of captured evaluated geometry, authoring records and resolved texture content.
- `render_digest`: Digest of the exact source scene and explicit rendering settings.
- `input_sha256`: Renderer hash of evaluated input, texture content and output view.
- `adapter_name`: Actual GPU adapter name, obtained only when a render executes.
- `adapter_backend`: Actual renderer backend, Metal on macOS or the selected WGPU backend elsewhere.
- `parameters`: Effective evaluated parameters keyed by stable document UUID.
- `visible_roi`: Actual viewport model extent [min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y], including aspect-ratio expansion.
- `scale`: Model-to-image scale. Image X=x*scale+offset[0], Y=-y*scale+offset[1].
- `offset`: Translation in top-left image pixels, parallel to the documented scale formula.
- `textures`: Source texture identities and exact content hashes shared across this batch.
- `drawable_bounds`: Drawable geometric image bounds in evaluated order; masks/occlusion are not pixel-tested here.
- `quality`: Mesh quality in evaluated drawable order when View.quality is true; empty otherwise.
Texture coverage uses alpha >= 8, pixel centers, at most a 256x256 grid, ignoring masks,
filtering and UV repeat outside [0,1]. A step above 1 denotes approximate coverage.

## zipzi.modeling.ObservationView

`(width: int, height: int, roi: tuple[float, float, float, float], padding_model: float = 0.0, topology: TopologyOverlay | None = None, quality: bool = False)`

Immutable owned ObservationView value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `width`: Output width in pixels, 1..4096, subject to device and Runtime budgets.
- `height`: Output height in pixels, 1..4096, subject to device and Runtime budgets.
- `roi`: Nonempty finite [min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y] in Y-up model coordinates.
- `padding_model`: Nonnegative padding around the ROI in model units; aspect ratio is preserved.
- `topology`: Optional topology overlay in the same frozen Source and ROI mapping. It ignores
masks and occlusion; None preserves the ordinary GPU image.
- `quality`: Include per-mesh evaluated quality and approximate source-alpha coverage.
Uses default parameters of the same source as reference; checks requested frames only.

- `id`: Stable document object ID used by references; it is distinct from the exported runtime_id.

- `part_id`: Owning Part object ID; it must name an existing Part rather than a root sentinel.

- `part_keyform_indices`: Part-keyform-to-Offscreen-keyform mapping; entries are keyform slots, not object IDs.
- `keyforms`: Shape samples for this binding; coordinate/sample identities must match its axes or key
table.

`(document_id: str, setup: ModelSetup, hierarchy_order: HierarchyOrder, editor_state: EditorState, display_info: DisplayInfo, model3_settings: Model3Settings, draw_order_groups: tuple[DrawOrderGroup, ...] | None = None, ids: _Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]], assets: tuple[ImageAsset | None, ...], meshes: tuple[Mesh | None, ...], parameters: tuple[Parameter | None, ...], parts: tuple[Part | None, ...], transforms: tuple[Transform | None, ...], bindings: tuple[MeshBinding | None, ...], scene_bindings: tuple[SceneBinding | None, ...], blend_key_tables: tuple[BlendShapeKeyTable | None, ...], blend_constraints: tuple[BlendShapeConstraint | None, ...], blend_bindings: tuple[BlendShapeBinding | None, ...], glues: tuple[Glue | None, ...], offscreens: tuple[Offscreen | None, ...], parameter_groups: tuple[CdiParameterGroup | None, ...], attachments: tuple[PackageAttachment | None, ...], motions: tuple[MotionClip | None, ...], motion_groups: tuple[MotionGroup | None, ...], motion_registrations: tuple[MotionRegistration | None, ...], expressions: tuple[ExpressionAsset | None, ...], physics: PhysicsAsset | None = None, pose: PoseAsset | None = None)`

Immutable owned OwnedModelingRecords value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

group list.

when no record payloads were requested.

requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `meshes`: Owned meshes aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a missing
requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `parameters`: Owned parameters aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a missing
requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `parts`: Owned Parts aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a missing requested
ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `transforms`: Owned deformation transforms aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a
missing requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `bindings`: Owned ordinary mesh bindings aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a
missing requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `scene_bindings`: Owned scene bindings aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a missing
requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `blend_key_tables`: Owned BlendShape key tables aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a
missing requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `blend_constraints`: Owned BlendShape constraints aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a
missing requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `blend_bindings`: Owned BlendShape bindings aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a
missing requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `glues`: Owned Glue objects aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a missing
requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `offscreens`: Owned Offscreen objects aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a
missing requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `parameter_groups`: Owned CDI parameter groups aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a
missing requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `attachments`: Owned package attachments aligned with the corresponding query ID list; None marks a
missing requested ID and an empty query returns no payloads.
- `motions`: Owned selected motions aligned with query IDs; None marks a missing ID.
- `motion_groups`: Owned selected motion_groups aligned with query IDs; None marks a missing ID.
- `motion_registrations`: Owned selected motion_registrations aligned with query IDs; None marks a missing ID.

- `particles`: Latest solved particle XY positions in the SDK solver coordinate system.

- `outputs`: Latest output observations; None marks an unavailable channel.

## zipzi.modeling.PoseCapabilities

`(inspect: CapabilityState, patch: CapabilityState, create_child: CapabilityState, duplicate: CapabilityState, delete: CapabilityState, move_object: CapabilityState, reorder: CapabilityState, repair: CapabilityState, dissolve: CapabilityState, preview: CapabilityState)`

Immutable owned PoseCapabilities value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `inspect`: Read this object while its identity/context remains valid.
- `patch`: Modify typed fields through a validated native intent/address.
- `create_child`: Create owned child rows in this object.
- `duplicate`: Duplicate the selected object while allocating fresh owned identities.
- `delete`: Delete the selected object subject to native reference and lock rules.
- `move_object`: Move the selected object between compatible native owners.
- `reorder`: Change ordered sibling membership without changing identity.
- `repair`: Repair an explicitly unresolved native reference.
- `dissolve`: Remove this container while moving owned content to an explicit destination.
- `preview`: Native preview eligibility; host preview API availability is advertised separately.

`(severity: str, code: str, object_id: str, message: str)`

Immutable owned ProjectDiagnostic value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `message`: Human-readable diagnostic detail; code is the stable programmatic discriminator.

## zipzi.modeling.ProjectReport

`(before: _Version, after: _Version, warnings: tuple[str, ...], diagnostics: tuple[ProjectDiagnostic, ...], published: bool, durable: bool, paths: tuple[str, ...])`

Immutable owned ProjectReport value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `before`: Exact SDK version before the operation.
- `after`: Exact SDK version after the operation; may equal before for a no-op or nonpublishing
operation.
- `warnings`: Nonfatal operation warnings retained even when an output was produced.
- `diagnostics`: Structured diagnostics from this query or operation; an empty list means none were reported.
- `published`: Whether the operation published its result; inspect durable separately for persistence
guarantees.
- `durable`: Whether the reported persistence step achieved its durability guarantee; job completion
alone does not imply true.
- `paths`: Host-side output paths actually reported by the operation; no client-side path
translation is implied.

## zipzi.modeling.ReparentEdit

`(sources: tuple[str, ...], parent_id: str, strategy: ReparentStrategy, placement: ReparentPlacement | None = None, tolerance: float, relative_tolerance: float = 1e-06, context: ReparentContext | None = None)`

Immutable owned ReparentEdit value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `sources`: Stable IDs of objects to reparent; source order is retained in the planned selection.
- `parent_id`: Empty means the model root. Part organization is an independent relation.
- `strategy`: Explicit reparenting/conversion strategy, including how shape differences are preserved
or reported.
- `placement`: Optional placement in the resulting deformation collection.
- `tolerance`: Absolute position error in model units, before Glue postprocessing.
- `relative_tolerance`: Relative error times the original affected geometry's model-space scale.
- `context`: Required for preservation. These are frozen native parameter inputs;
Motion/Physics must first be resolved to parameters by the caller.

## zipzi.modeling.SceneEditCreate

`(id: str, name: str, object: SceneCreate, part_id: str | None = None, parent_id: str | None = None, before: str | None = None, deformation_before: str | None = None)`

Immutable owned SceneEditCreate value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `id`: New stable UUID for this object; it must not conflict with an existing identity.
- `name`: Human-readable display name; use the stable ID for identity because names can change.
- `object`: Native scene object kind and its creation options; not a persisted full object record.
- `part_id`: Organizational Part owner ID; independent of the deformation parent. None selects
the root/unassigned container.
- `parent_id`: Parent object ID in this hierarchy; independent of storage and drawing order. None
selects the root/unassigned container.
- `before`: Stable anchor in the organization collection (`part_id`), or the
connection collection for Glue. None appends to that collection.
- `deformation_before`: Independent stable anchor in the deformation collection (`parent_id`).
Only Mesh/Warp/Rotation support this position; None appends.

## zipzi.modeling.TextureCoverage

`(alpha_threshold: int, pixel_step: int, sampled_pixels: int, covered_pixels: int, transparent_covered_pixels: int, opaque_pixels: int, uncovered_opaque_pixels: int, transparent_coverage_fraction: float | None = None, uncovered_opaque_fraction: float | None = None, out_of_bounds_triangles: int)`

Immutable owned TextureCoverage value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `alpha_threshold`: Alpha >= this value counts as painted. Coverage ignores filtering, masks and occlusion.
- `pixel_step`: Top-down source-pixel grid spacing. Values above 1 mean an approximate report.
- `sampled_pixels`: Number of source pixel centers tested on the regular grid.
- `covered_pixels`: Tested pixel centers covered by the union of UV triangles inside [0,1].
- `transparent_covered_pixels`: Covered centers whose source alpha is below the threshold.
- `opaque_pixels`: Tested centers whose source alpha is at least the threshold.
- `uncovered_opaque_pixels`: Opaque centers outside the UV triangle union: a contour coverage error, not a distance.
- `transparent_coverage_fraction`: Transparent covered / covered; None if no tested center is covered.
- `uncovered_opaque_fraction`: Uncovered opaque / opaque; None for an entirely transparent sampled image.
- `out_of_bounds_triangles`: Number of UV triangles with vertices outside [0,1]; repeat-sampled coverage is not measured.

## zipzi.modeling.TopologyOverlay

`(targets: tuple[ObjectTarget, ...] | None = None, wireframe: bool = True, vertices: bool = False, vertex_ids: bool = False, constraints: bool = False, strain: bool = False, include_hidden: bool = False, topology_only: bool = False, heat_opacity: float = 0.25, anomalies_only: bool = False, thresholds: TopologyThresholds = field(default_factory=lambda: read_TopologyThresholds({'max_aspect_ratio': 20.0, 'max_edge_stretch': 2.0, 'min_angle_degrees': 10.0})), label_scale: int = 2, label_spacing: int = 3, max_labels: int = 256)`

Immutable owned TopologyOverlay value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `targets`: Diagnostic selection only; the textured context image is unchanged. None selects all
meshes, Some([]) selects none. Mesh/Part targets are unioned and deduplicated;
Parts include nested Parts. Missing targets fail explicitly. Maximum 256 selectors.
- `wireframe`: Draw triangle edges in cyan, in final evaluated model coordinates.
- `vertices`: Draw vertex positions as yellow dots.
- `vertex_ids`: Draw stable authoring vertex IDs in yellow, rather than transient array offsets.
- `constraints`: Draw meshing boundary edges in green and internal constraints in magenta.
- `strain`: Fill triangles by symmetric edge stretch relative to the default pose: blue=1,
orange=2, red>=4; flipped or collapsed triangles are magenta.
- `include_hidden`: Include disabled, hidden and zero-opacity meshes. Default draws visible meshes only.
- `topology_only`: Clear the textured image before diagnostic drawing, retaining the exact same view.
- `heat_opacity`: Heat fill opacity in [0,1]. Applied once per pixel using the most severe overlapping
triangle, so overlapping layers cannot accumulate opacity. Lines and labels stay opaque.
- `anomalies_only`: Restrict every diagnostic layer to anomalous triangles and their incident vertices/edges.
Degenerate, flipped and undefined-reference triangles always count as anomalies.
- `thresholds`: Thresholds used by anomalies_only; reports themselves are never threshold-filtered.
- `label_scale`: Decimal glyph scale in output pixels, 1..4. Labels avoid other labels globally;
an ID is omitted when no nearby in-view position has enough space.
- `label_spacing`: Minimum clear gap between label rectangles in pixels, 0..32.
- `max_labels`: Maximum labels per image, 0..4096. Vertex dots remain independent of this limit.

## zipzi.modeling.TopologyReplacement

`(mesh: Mesh, binding: MeshBinding | None = None, blend_bindings: tuple[BlendShapeBinding, ...], glues: tuple[Glue, ...], vertex_mapping: _Mapping[int, int | None])`

Immutable owned TopologyReplacement value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `mesh`: Complete replacement mesh geometry and metadata. Setting meshing to None explicitly
discards previous modeling topology; ordinary mesh replacements must preserve it.
- `binding`: Optional replacement ordinary mesh binding; None supplies no ordinary binding.
- `blend_bindings`: Complete replacement BlendShape bindings for the remeshed object.
- `glues`: Complete replacement Glue records affected by the remesh.
- `vertex_mapping`: Old vertex ID to replacement ID map; Some(new_id) remaps an identity and None explicitly
removes it.

## zipzi.modeling.TopologyThresholds

`(min_angle_degrees: float = 10.0, max_aspect_ratio: float = 20.0, max_edge_stretch: float = 2.0)`

Immutable owned TopologyThresholds value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `min_angle_degrees`: An angle below this value is anomalous; finite degrees in [0,60]. Default 10.
- `max_aspect_ratio`: A longest-edge/altitude ratio above this is anomalous; finite and >= 1. Default 20.
- `max_edge_stretch`: A symmetric edge-length ratio above this is anomalous; finite and >= 1. Default 2.

## zipzi.modeling.Transform

`(id: str, runtime_id: str, name: str, part_id: PartId | None = None, parent_id: TransformId | None = None, data: TransformData, enabled: bool, appearance: Appearance)`

Immutable owned Transform value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `id`: Stable document object ID used by references; it is distinct from the exported runtime_id.
- `runtime_id`: External format/runtime identifier retained for import/export; not the document object ID.
- `name`: Human-readable display name; use the stable ID for identity because names can change.
- `part_id`: Organizational Part owner ID; independent of the deformation parent. None selects the
root/unassigned container.
- `parent_id`: Parent object ID in this hierarchy; independent of storage and drawing order. None
selects the root/unassigned container.
- `data`: Typed Warp or Rotation deformation definition; its variant determines lattice versus
rotation-pose interpretation.
- `enabled`: Whether this object participates in evaluation; editor hiding is a separate state.
- `appearance`: Opacity and multiply/screen color factors for this object or shape.

## zipzi.modeling.TriangleHit

`(triangle_index: int, vertex_indices: tuple[int, int, int], vertex_ids: tuple[int, int, int] | None = None, barycentric: tuple[float, float, float], uv: tuple[float, float] | None = None)`

Immutable owned TriangleHit value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `triangle_index`: The triangle's zero-based position in the drawable's index buffer.
- `vertex_indices`: Offsets into the evaluated drawable's vertex arrays.
- `vertex_ids`: Stable authoring vertex IDs, when present.
- `barycentric`: Interpolation weights corresponding to `vertex_indices`.
- `uv`: UV coordinate interpolated from the triangle's evaluated UVs.

## zipzi.modeling.TriangleQuality

`(triangle_index: int, area: float, min_angle_degrees: float, aspect_ratio: float | None = None, relative_area: float | None = None, edge_stretch: float | None = None)`

Immutable owned TriangleQuality value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `triangle_index`: Zero-based triangle offset, in the sampled drawable's index order.
- `area`: Unsigned evaluated area in model units squared.
- `min_angle_degrees`: Smallest interior angle in degrees; zero for a collapsed triangle.
- `aspect_ratio`: Longest edge divided by its altitude. None for a collapsed triangle.
- `relative_area`: Signed area / signed default-pose area. Negative means flipped; None if the reference is degenerate.
- `edge_stretch`: Largest symmetric edge-length ratio max(current/reference, reference/current).
None if any reference or sampled edge is collapsed. A rigid transform gives 1.

## zipzi.modeling.WarpBezier

`(rows: int, columns: int, nodes: tuple[WarpBezierNode, ...])`

Immutable owned WarpBezier value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `rows`: Number of warp lattice cells vertically; a lattice has rows + 1 point rows.
- `columns`: Number of warp lattice cells horizontally; a lattice has columns + 1 point columns.
- `nodes`: Bezier nodes in row-major order; exactly (rows + 1) * (columns + 1) nodes.

## zipzi.modeling.WarpBezierNode

`(position: Vec2, handles: tuple[Vec2, Vec2, Vec2, Vec2])`

Immutable owned WarpBezierNode value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `position`: Absolute Bezier anchor position in lattice coordinates; not a handle offset.
- `handles`: Absolute positions: left, right, up, down in lattice coordinates.

## zipzi.modeling.WarpKeyform

`(bezier: WarpBezier | None = None, samples: tuple[str, ...] = (), positions: tuple[Vec2, ...], appearance: Appearance)`

Immutable owned WarpKeyform value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `bezier`: Optional Bezier controller for this warp shape; None means this shape has no controller.
- `samples`: Stable sample IDs in active binding-axis order.
- `positions`: Absolute warp lattice positions in row-major point order; not displacement vectors.
- `appearance`: Opacity and multiply/screen color factors for this object or shape.

## zipzi.modeling.WarpPointPatch

`(row: int, column: int, point: Vec2)`

Immutable owned WarpPointPatch value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `row`: Zero-based lattice point row, in the inclusive range 0..rows.
- `column`: Zero-based lattice point column, in the inclusive range 0..columns.
- `point`: Replacement lattice XY value: absolute for Base/Ordinary, displacement for BlendShape.

## zipzi.modeling.WarpTransform

`(bezier: WarpBezier | None = None, rows: int, columns: int, quad: bool, points: tuple[Vec2, ...])`

Immutable owned WarpTransform value. Construction owns declared collections; reading fields, repr and summary performs no IO.

- `bezier`: Optional authoring Bezier controller; None leaves the baked lattice without a controller.
- `rows`: Number of warp lattice cells vertically; a lattice has rows + 1 point rows.
- `columns`: Number of warp lattice cells horizontally; a lattice has columns + 1 point columns.
- `quad`: Whether to use the quad warp interpolation mode for the lattice.
- `points`: Absolute lattice points in row-major order; index = row * (columns + 1) + column.
